entities.summary: Hendrik ("Hein") van der Zee was a boxer from the Netherlands, who competed for his native country at the 1952 Summer Olympics in Helsinki, Finland. There he was defeated in the first round of the Men's Flyweight (–51 kg) division by Anatoli Bulakov of the Soviet Union.
